summary: Iteration 18 - Achievement Badge System, Profile Features & Microsoft Integrations testing completed. All 28 backend API tests passed (after fixing MongoDB ObjectId serialization bug). Frontend UI testing verified all new features: Achievements tab with earned/all badges, Profile tab with avatar upload/edit profile/Teams status buttons, hover card on tech avatar showing status/sessions/tickets/badge count, and Clients M365 tab with tenant sync and user table.

User user-001 (Alex Thompson) has 4 earned badges: First Resolve, Revenue Starter, Birthday Star (admin awarded), 1 Year Anniversary (admin awarded). Profile tab shows about_me, hire_date, birthday fields with Change Photo, Edit Profile, and Teams Status buttons. Hover card on tech avatar shows real-time status (remote sessions with duration, assigned tickets, badge count). Clients M365 tab shows tenant config and synced users. Microsoft Teams/CIPP/M365 settings stored but actual API calls are MOCKED (returns 'not configured' when disabled).

bug_fixed.description: Fixed MongoDB ObjectId serialization error in POST /api/technicians/{id}/achievements/award endpoint
bug_fixed.root_cause: After insert_one(), the entry dict gets a MongoDB _id field (ObjectId type) which is not JSON serializable
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Added entry.pop('_id', None) before returning the response in award_achievement function (line 2156-2157)
